caller_first_name.description: The caller's confirmed first name from earlier in the call.

caller_last_name.description: The caller's confirmed last name, including spelling confirmation.

caller_phone.description: The caller's 10-digit phone number, digits only, as confirmed by digit repeat-back.

caller_email.description: The caller's email address as confirmed by character spell-out.

service_type.description: The type of consultation selected: Buyer Consultation, Seller Consultation, or Investment Review.

preferred_window_1.description: The caller's first preferred time window including timezone.

preferred_window_2.description: The caller's second preferred time window if given; empty string if not.

preferred_window_3.description: The caller's third preferred time window if given; empty string if not.
